name: workspace_check
description: Verify host workspace snapshot files, workspace path engine tag, and guest test_binaries_dir

test_steps.desc: Verify workspace contains snapshot qcow2 files
Verify workspace path contains expected engine tag prefix
Verify test_binaries_dir content was uploaded to guest
test_steps.guest_run: if (Test-Path '@test_binaries_dir@\dummy_ci_marker.txt') { Write-Output 'PASS: test binaries uploaded' } else { throw 'dummy_ci_marker.txt not found in @test_binaries_dir@' }
